name: create_makefile_c_build
description: Writes a Makefile that compiles, cleans, and tests a C program
prompts: This directory has main.c and greet.c (main calls greet(), which prints 'hello from make'). Write a Makefile with three targets: `make` (or `make all`) compiles both sources into an executable named `app` (use gcc); `make clean` removes `app` and any object files; `make test` depends on the build and runs ./app, treating a zero exit as success. clean and test must be declared .PHONY so they work even if files named 'clean' or 'test' exist. Recipe lines must be tab-indented.

setup_files.greet.c:
#include <stdio.h>
int greet(void) { printf("hello from make\n"); return 0; }

test_setup_files.test_make.py:
import os, subprocess, time

def make(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['make', *args], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)

r = make()
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make failed: {r.stderr}'
assert os.path.exists('app'), 'make must produce ./app'

out = subprocess.run(['./app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert out.returncode == 0, f'./app exit {out.returncode}'

r = make('test')
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make test failed: {r.stderr}'
assert 'hello from make' in r.stdout, f'make test must run ./app: {r.stdout!r}'

# .PHONY robustness: a file named 'test' that is NEWER than its prerequisite
# `app` makes non-.PHONY make declare the target up-to-date and SKIP the
# recipe. `app` already exists and is untouched here, so creating `test` now
# leaves it strictly newer - the discriminating case.
time.sleep(1.1)
open('test', 'w').close()
r = make('test')
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make test errored with a shadowing file: {r.stderr!r}'
assert 'hello from make' in r.stdout, \
    f'make test was skipped because a newer file named test exists (missing .PHONY): {r.stdout!r}'

r = make('clean')
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make clean failed: {r.stderr}'
assert not os.path.exists('app'), 'make clean must remove app'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC = gcc
CFLAGS = -Wall

app: main.c greet.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o app main.c greet.c

all: app

.PHONY: all clean test

clean:
	rm -f app *.o test

test: app
	./app
